column1: # Uzbek inflectional affix surfaces, keyed on the Layer 1 search key.
# GENERATED from UzMorphAnalyser affixes.csv (Salaev, MIT). Do not hand-edit.
# The source enumerates whole affix CHAINS rather than slots, so this is a
# surface list: -larimizdangina is one entry, not four. Optional buffer
# segments (i) (a) (t) (s) (n) and the archiphonemes T=d/t G=g/k/q Y=a/y
# Q=q/g/k are expanded into every surface here.
# Every POS the source gives a surface is listed, because one surface
# often serves several: -i is a possessive on a noun and part of a verb
# ending elsewhere. The analyzer uses this to reject a verb affix sitting
# on a stem the lexicon calls a noun.
